title: 1 Peter Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 Peter 5: shepherding the flock, humility under God's hand, and the final greetings.

questions.text: As what does the writer exhort the elders in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ.

answers.text: As a teacher of the law
As a younger one among them
As a judge over the assembly

questions.text: How are the elders to exercise the oversight, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to shepherd the flock of God, exercising the oversight not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly.

answers.text: For gain, as is their due

questions.text: Instead of lording it over those entrusted to them, what should they be?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

questions.text: What will they receive when the chief Shepherd is revealed?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says that when the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn't fade away.

questions.text: Whom does the saying quoted in verse 5 say God resists?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 quotes: God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

questions.text: Why can they cast all their worries on him, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

answers.text: Because he is far above all

questions.text: What is the devil compared to in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

questions.text: What will the God of all grace do after they have suffered a little while?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says that the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory, will perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

answers.text: Call them to a new land

questions.text: Through whom does verse 12 say this letter was written?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly.

questions.text: How are they told in verse 14 to greet one another?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: greet one another with a kiss of love; peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus.
